dsBanner_other: Moving from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{date}} · {{count}} will be over the limit

pgWhen: On {{date}}, at period end. Nothing changes before that, and nothing is refunded.

pkAutoReq: Buy a {{size}} pack when requests reach 100%
pkCap: At most 3 packs a cycle by themselves; with no balance it stops.
